Title: Schema.org has cross-site scripting (XSS) via script break-out in toScript() output
Description: Schema.org has a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via script break-out in toScript() output.
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 3.23.1 before 3.23.2, all versions starting from 4.0.0 before 4.0.2
NotImpacted: All versions before 3.23.1, all versions starting from 3.23.2 before 4.0.0, all versions starting from 4.0.2
